name: Heaven of Blood Legerdemain
body:
Also known as the Path of Blood Rise, this path reveals to the bloodlord the means by which they can manipulate their bloodline to excel in different aspects, boost their innate talents, and temporarily evolve their physiology to display the bloodlines of those they choose to emulate.

Base Attack Bonus: Equal to 3/4 their class level.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency: This path grants proficiency in any all light armor, simple weapons, and any two martial weapons that are not restricted for learning.

Class Skills: Bluff (Cha), Diplomacy (Cha), Disable Device (Dex), Disguise (Cha), Escape Artist (Dex), Perform (Cha), Sense Motive (Wis), Sleight of Hand (Dex), and Stealth (Dex).

Bonus Blood Talent: At 1st level, a bloodlord who chooses the heaven of blood legerdemain as their specialization gains either bloodhound, bloodshed expert, or bloody manufacturer as a bonus blood talent in addition to their first blood talent.

Heaven of Blood Legerdemain Bloodline Limits

A bloodlord can select a bonus feat (with any of the following tags shown below) or any one of the following options (from any of the classes shown below for each option): a bonus deed (see below for more details), ninja trick, or talent.

Feats: betrayal, conduit, damnation, grit, hero point, item mastery, panache, performance, and teamwork. The bloodlord may choose Amateur Gunslinger, Amateur Investigator, and Amateur Swashbuckler instead as a bonus feat.
Deeds: the bloodlord must have the Amateur Gunslinger or Amateur Swashbuckler feat; if they already have levels in gunslinger or swashbuckler, the bloodlord cannot chose this option; gunslinger (core), swashbuckler (core); each time the bloodlord selects this option, they select a deed that is available to them based on their effective gunslinger or swashbuckler levels.
Ninja Tricks: ninja (core, Legendary), including master tricks.
Talents: investigator (core, Legendary), rogue (core, unchained, and Legendary), and vigilante (from the stalker specialization only), including advanced talents.

If a chosen bonus feat/deed/ninja trick/talent selected has additional benefits that use a resource point cost, such as grit, jutsu, ki, or panache, the bloodlord can spend sanguine points from their blood bank as a free action to gain resource points that is immediately spent to gain the benefits listed in the chosen bonus feat/deed/ninja trick/talent from spending the relevant resource point cost.

The bloodlord can obtain 1 resource point for every 4 sanguine points of blood they spend in this way. The bloodlord cannot spend the resource point gained this way on anything else but to gain the listed benefits through expending the resource point(s) cost of the chosen bonus feat/deed/ninja trick/talent and any unspent resource point is lost at the start of the bloodlord’s next turn.

If the bonus feat/deed/ninja trick/talent has a BAB requirement of +11 or higher or a specific class level of 10 or higher, the bloodlord can only obtain 1 resource point for every 8 sanguine points they spend in this way – this represents the increased difficulty in mimicking the true exemplars of such abilities.

This does not grant the bloodlord a resource pool, thus they cannot benefit from any chosen bonus feat/deed/ninja trick/talent that requires a resource pool unless they already possess the relevant resource pool via another source, such as a class. The bloodlord cannot recover any resource point for the chosen bonus feat/deed/ninja trick/talent unless they already possess the means to do so via another source, such as a class.

Once the choice is made, the bloodlord cannot freely change the choice, but they can retrain the choice as per the retraining rules for a chosen bonus feat, deed, ninja trick, or talent, if appropriate.
